_note: Permanent rewards for beating bosses and mini bosses. 'flag' is set by the fight's victory; stats stack. 'card' is the Latin victory card, 'gift' the line under it.

lacrima.name: Lacrima
lacrima.gift: Lacrima — one more holy water flask.

crusnik.name: The Crusnik
crusnik.gift: The Crusnik has woken. Fill the blue bar, then press ABIL.

corLeonis.name: Cor Leonis
corLeonis.gift: Cor Leonis — your life grows stronger.

vox.name: Vox Silentii
vox.gift: The strings are silent. The bridge to the count's castle is open.

frater.name: Frater
frater.gift: Frater — a brother's lance, broken. Your life grows stronger.

fides.name: Fides
fides.gift: Fides — a captain's word, kept. One more flask.
